items.t: The Crest is a residential sub-area in south-east Burnaby, on the Edmonds / East Burnaby side of the city near the New Westminster border; the residential area surrounds The Crest Centre, around 10th Avenue, 6th Street and Edmonds Street. Nearby: Edmonds town centre to the west, East Burnaby and Cariboo to the north, and New Westminster across the municipal border to the east and south-east.

Where the condo stock concentrates: there is very little of it, and what is known by name is townhouse form, not apartment form — the named complexes in cluster on Cumberland Street and Cumberland Place at the sub-area's north side (Deerfield, Wildflower, Chancery Lane).

Main streets and transit anchors: 10th Avenue, 6th Street, Edmonds Street and Kingsway serve the area, and the New Westminster border is at the east edge. Edmonds Station (Expo Line) is west of the sub-area and is its SkyTrain link; no SkyTrain station sits inside The Crest.

Civic anchors: the Tommy Douglas Branch of Burnaby Public Library, 7311 Kingsway, serves this quadrant from Edmonds, west of the sub-area; the Edmonds Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #201-7315 Edmonds St, and the city's hospital is Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St, in central Burnaby.

City-wide direction is the Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan, adopted December 9, 2025, which replaces the 1998 OCP and takes precedence over older community-plan land use maps where they conflict; the Edmonds Community Plan covers the town centre plan area west of The Crest.

items.t: Burnaby rewrote its zoning bylaw in 2026, and the old one is repealed. Zoning Bylaw 2026 (No. 14815) was adopted June 9, 2026 and took effect July 1, 2026 — any Crest document, listing or appraisal still citing Zoning Bylaw 1965 (No. 4742) is citing a repealed bylaw. The Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan (adopted December 9, 2025) sits above it and takes precedence over older community-plan land use maps where they conflict.
The sub-area's name is a shopping plaza, not a City neighbourhood. Searches and documents should carry "Burnaby" and a street name, not the sub-area name alone.

The Edmonds towers are not Crest stock, however the listing is written. Kings Crossing and its neighbouring towers stand west of the sub-area at Edmonds Station and are filed under Edmonds BE in current listings — a Crest search that imports their prices, ages or amenity sets is comparing a station-area tower market to a house-and-townhouse pocket.

The three townhouse complexes sit together, and that is the attached market. Deerfield (7501 Cumberland Street), Wildflower (7500 Cumberland Street) and Chancery Lane (8533 Cumberland Place) cluster on the Cumberland streets at the sub-area's north side, near Burnaby Lake — Wildflower and Chancery Lane listings both trade on the greenbelt and park access there. A Crest townhouse buyer's real choice is between these three stratas and their depreciation reports, not between neighbourhoods.

items.t: City zoning and plan — Burnaby's current pair: Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026 (No. 14815) was adopted June 9, 2026 and took effect July 1, 2026; the former Zoning Bylaw 1965 (No. 4742) is repealed. City-wide direction is the Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan, adopted December 9, 2025, which replaces the 1998 OCP and takes precedence over older community-plan land use maps where they conflict; the Edmonds Community Plan covers the town centre plan area west of The Crest.

SSMUH / suite rules as the City states them: Burnaby consolidated its former single- and two-family districts into one R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing District in June 2024 — R1 lots may hold 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop; SSMUH lots require a minimum lot width of 10 m and minimum lot area of 281 m²; permitted forms include single-family homes, duplexes, multiplexes, rowhouses and secondary suites, and lots with two or more primary units may be stratified. That last point is the future townhouse-form supply line for Crest house lots — a permitted form today, not a counted complex.

blocks.text: The Crest home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 townhomes sold in The Crest with a median price of $1,135,000 (the middle half sold between $1,120,250 and $1,214,625), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 21% sold above list. They had a median $625 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $463 a month.

faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® counted 6 condos and townhomes listed in The Crest at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in The Crest?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in The Crest had a sales ratio of 50% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is The Crest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 7 condos and townhomes sold in The Crest over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in The Crest from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: A buyer who needs an apartment unit should also search Edmonds BE, the separate sub-area at Edmonds Station.
faq.q: Are there apartment condos in The Crest at all?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, whatever older bylaw or directory text says. Short-term rentals are a different question that a strata bylaw can still restrict; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Crest townhouse long-term?

faq.a: Burnaby-wide that month, the Condos & Townhomes median was $686,000 at 98% sale-to-list over 36 days; SnapStats publishes no Crest-specific median.
faq.q: How active is The Crest market?

faq.a: The schools in or beside the sub-area on the Province's list are Second Street Community Elementary (K–7), 7502 2nd St, and Morley Elementary (K–7), 7355 Morley St, with Byrne Creek Community Secondary (8–12), 7777 18th St, the nearest secondary. SD41 has no middle-school tier.
faq.q: Which schools serve a Crest address?

faq.a: No — Edmonds Station on the Expo Line, west of the sub-area, is the SkyTrain link. Listings that price a Crest home as "steps to SkyTrain" are overstating it; measure the walk or bus link to Edmonds Station for the specific address.
faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in The Crest?

faq.a: Three strata complexes, all on the Cumberland streets at the sub-area's north side: Deerfield (7501 Cumberland Street, 105 units per its listing description), Wildflower (7500 Cumberland Street, Polygon, Freehold Strata) and Chancery Lane (8533 Cumberland Place, Ledingham McAllister, built 2006). That cluster is the attached market; there is no known apartment-condo alternative in the sub-area and no fee-simple townhouse complex.
faq.q: What townhouses can I actually buy in The Crest?

faq.a: Strata — Wildflower's listings state Freehold Strata title expressly, and Deerfield and Chancery Lane trade as strata townhouses with strata fees and bylaws on their listings.
faq.q: Are the three complexes strata or freehold?

faq.a: Yes under provincial law — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since Nov 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, whatever older bylaw or directory text says (the directory lines in any case record rentals allowed, with restrictions at Deerfield). Short-term rentals are a different question a strata bylaw can still restrict; check the registered bylaws on the Form B.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Crest townhouse long-term?
What did townhomes in The Crest sell for?
faq.a: The median townhome sale in The Crest was $1,135,000, across 14 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in The Crest?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 18 days. At the median, sale prices were 98.0% of list, and 21% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
